mapr

mapr makes it easier to produce clean, projected maps in R. Given a set of locations, for example from a tagged marine animal, mapr() fetches a coastline from the Natural Earth database, crops it to your study area and projects it, ready for plotting with ggplot2 and sf. make_map_furniture() then adds a proper frame and graticule labels to turn the plot into a finished map.

Installation

Install the development version from GitHub:

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("jamesgrecian/mapr", build_vignettes = TRUE)

Getting started

The guide walks through building a publication-ready map of seabird tracks, step by step:

vignette("mapr")
